tasks.title: Project scaffold, Tailwind, Vite API bridge & Vercel config
tasks.description: Set up package.json, tsconfig (strict), Tailwind CSS, Vite config with shared serverless API middleware, .env.example, and vercel.json.
tasks.details: Install React 19, TypeScript, Vite, Tailwind, SheetJS (xlsx), Lucide icons, @vercel/node types.
tasks.testStrategy: npm run build and tsc --noEmit succeed.

tasks.title: Historical Data Parser & Sample Datasets
tasks.description: Implement auto-detecting CSV/TSV/Excel parser for Simple Date/Vol, 48x7 Heatmap, Cross-Tab Pivot (Interval x Dates), and Long format plus realistic sample datasets.
tasks.details: Single cross-tab upload populates both daily forecasting series and per-day-of-week arrival pattern % curves.
tasks.testStrategy: Unit tests verifying all 4 formats including blank cells as zero and ignoring Total rows.

tasks.title: Tab 1 Forecasting Studio Engine (Conrad Carlberg)
tasks.description: Implement Unweighted MA, Weighted MA, SES, Holt Linear, Holt-Winters Add/Mult & Seasonal Indices, Linear Regression, 80/20 chronological split, Outlier/Holiday cleaning, MultiStart auto-optimizer, and Granularity Bridge.
tasks.details: Compute MAPE, WMAPE, sMAPE, RMSE, MAE/MAD, Forecast Bias %, and auto-rank best model.
tasks.testStrategy: Unit tests against Conrad Carlberg Ch.2-4 numerical identities and edge cases.

tasks.title: Tab 2 Interval & Erlang C/A Staffing Engine
tasks.description: Implement overflow-safe recursive Erlang B/C, multi-constraint integer solver (SL, Max ASA, Max Occupancy Cap, Min Floor), and true Palm/Erlang-A abandonment modeling.
tasks.details: Support 60/30/15-min intervals, 24/7 or custom hours, and per-interval AHT overrides.
tasks.testStrategy: Verify Erlang B/C/SL/ASA against ErlangXL97 Module1 values and test high traffic A > 500 without overflow.

tasks.title: Tab 3 Capacity & Shrinkage FTE Waterfall + What-If Matrix
tasks.description: Implement Erlang C Route vs Flat Top-Down Route, break-separated paid shift hours, compound In/Out-of-office shrinkage, weekly Operating/Agent days scaling, Schedule Inflexibility, Attrition Buffer, and 2D sensitivity matrix.
tasks.details: Zero Occupancy double-counting in Erlang C route; zero break double-counting.
tasks.testStrategy: Verify against Cap Plan Excel math (240 prod hrs, 9-1=8 login, 3% in-office, 7/5 weekly, 1.1 inflex, 20% OOO -> 60 FTE).

tasks.title: SharePoint List + Power Automate Dual-Channel OTP Auth Gate
tasks.description: Implement lib/auth-core.ts shared by api/auth/*.ts Vercel Serverless functions and Vite dev middleware with HMAC-SHA256 HttpOnly cookie sessions, Teams + Outlook channel selection, and fail-closed security.
tasks.details: Supports explicit AUTH_MODE=demo preview challenge mode when PA webhook URLs are not yet connected.
tasks.testStrategy: Unit test HMAC cookie signing/verification, expiry, fail-closed when unconfigured, and Outlook/Teams request payloads.

tasks.title: Comprehensive Unit Test Suite & QA Verification
tasks.description: Write and execute deterministic Node test suite covering parsers, forecasting, Erlang C/A, capacity waterfall, and auth security.
tasks.details: Run via npm test using node --test.
tasks.testStrategy: 100% tests pass after all engine edits.

tasks.title: Operate-Mode UI Design System, Bilingual AR/EN Shell & Login Gate
tasks.description: Design restrained, daylight-precision WFM command center shell, RTL/LTR bilingual switcher, Auth Login Gate (Email + Teams/Outlook OTP), and in-app SharePoint/Power Automate Setup Wizard.
tasks.details: Zero generic slop, tabular-nums on all metrics, accessible keyboard controls.
tasks.testStrategy: Verified visually at desktop and mobile viewports in both AR and EN.

tasks.title: 3-Tab Interactive UI, Precision SVG Charts & Multi-Sheet Excel/PDF Export
tasks.description: Build Tab 1 Forecasting Studio, Tab 2 Interval & Erlang C/A Planner (+ 48x7 heatmap), Tab 3 Capacity Waterfall + What-If Matrix, and SheetJS multi-sheet .xlsx + printable PDF export.
tasks.details: Direct Granularity Bridge button from Tab 1 -> Tab 2 and Productive Hours live link Tab 2 -> Tab 3.
tasks.testStrategy: Interactive flow tested end-to-end in real browser; exported .xlsx verified.

tasks.title: Power Automate + SharePoint Docs, GitHub/Vercel Readiness & E2E Browser Check
